name: True match
statement: A customer and a listed party are a true match when the names agree at or above the policy threshold, the date of birth agrees to the day, and either the customer's nationality equals a nationality or citizenship of the listed party or a document number matches.

name: Counterparty match
statement: A payment counterparty matches a listed party when the counterparty name agrees at or above the policy threshold and the counterparty's country is one of the countries linked to the listed party. A counterparty with no usable country cannot be cleared.

name: False positive
statement: An alert is a false positive when the names are similar but the customer's date of birth conflicts with every date of birth listed for the party (it differs by more than the listed precision), the customer's nationality is not a nationality or citizenship of the listed party, and no document number matches.

name: Strong identifier
statement: A strong identifier is a date of birth that agrees to the day, a nationality that equals a nationality or citizenship of the listed party, or a document number that matches. An address country alone is not a strong identifier, and a year-only date of birth is not a strong identifier.

name: Effective ownership threshold
statement: A person controls a company when their effective ownership, added up along every ownership path, reaches the threshold in the active policy (50 percent by default). Exactly the threshold counts. A missing percentage is treated as unknown, never as zero.
